title: Tritonal at EDC Mexico City 2022 (Kinetic Field)
description:
Over 50,000 people in attendance for EDC Mexico City, we had an absolute blast  showcasing some classics as well as a handful of new records over this 70+ Minute Set.  Loved experiencing HALIENE perform Live for the last two records, we also debut'd a new single with up and coming producers, The Last Heroes.   Enjoy the show!

Subscribe for more videos: http://bit.ly/1yW9DTk
